  String area({required int w, required int h, int scale = 1}) {
    return 'a=${(w * h) * scale}';
  }

  String run() {
    var p = Point(x: 3, y: 4);
    var q = Point(y: 6, x: 5, tag: 'q');
    return '${p.show()}|${q.show()}|${area(w: 2, h: 3)}|${area(h: 3, w: 2, scale: 10)}';
  }

class Point {

  int x = 0;
  int y = 0;
  String tag = '';

  Point({required this.x, required this.y, this.tag = 'p'});

  String show() {
    return '$tag($x,$y)';
  }

}
